topic: Never share a one-time password (OTP) or PIN, not even with someone claiming to be from your bank.

episode.title: Your Secret Code Stays Secret

shots.narration: Would you hand your secret code to a convincing caller?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D animated modern flat, smartphone displaying four plain circular dots, no text or letters.
shots.action: Kash reaches toward the glowing smartphone.
shots.mood: Intriguing, warm lighting with a sharp red glow around the phone.

shots.narration: Kash gets a call claiming to be from her bank.
shots.scene: Clean modern flat, mustard sofa, small notebook on a side table, phone screen showing only a generic classical-building pictogram.
shots.action: Kash lifts the phone to her ear.
shots.mood: Ordinary and relaxed, bright friendly colours.

shots.narration: [surprised] Then comes the request: share your one-time password, or OTP.
shots.scene: Close view in the flat, smartphone screen showing four circular dots beneath a simple outward arrow, no writing.
shots.action: Kash lowers the phone to inspect its screen.
shots.mood: Uncertain, raised eyebrows and a small red screen glow.

shots.narration: Kash reaches for her code, but Coin raises a warning.
shots.scene: Modern flat, Kash holding the smartphone, her finger poised beside its dotted screen, no text.
shots.action: Coin raises one tiny palm between Kash and the phone.
shots.mood: Alert but friendly, clear stop gesture.

shots.narration: Never share an OTP or PIN with anyone.
shots.scene: Bright flat, close-up of Coin beside a floating cluster of four dots, no letters or numbers.
shots.action: Coin covers the four dots with a large shield-shaped panel.
shots.mood: Reassuring and firm, cool blue shield against warm gold.

shots.narration: [whispers] Not even someone claiming to be from your bank.
shots.scene: Flat side table, smartphone showing a generic classical-building pictogram, Kash watching beside Coin.
shots.action: Coin makes a firm stop gesture toward the smartphone.
shots.mood: Calm certainty, clear silhouettes and bright lighting.

shots.narration: Kash refuses the request and puts her phone down.
shots.scene: Modern flat, uncluttered side table beside the mustard sofa, Coin smiling nearby.
shots.action: Kash places the smartphone face down on the table.
shots.mood: Relieved, relaxed shoulders and warm sunlight.

shots.narration: Coin's lesson: keep those secret codes to yourself.
shots.scene: Bright flat, a floating shield enclosing four circular dots between Kash and Coin, no text.
shots.action: Kash gives Coin a confident thumbs-up.
shots.mood: Friendly payoff, cheerful gold and blue colours.

shots.narration: [excited] Practice refusing code requests today; next time, spot suspicious money promises.
shots.scene: Modern flat, face-down phone on the table, an oversized floating bubble containing a glittering pile of coins in the background, no writing.
shots.action: Kash practices a clear palm-out refusal toward the phone.
shots.mood: Empowered and playful, suspiciously dazzling gold bubble teasing the next episod

episode.endHook: Next time, can Kash spot a suspicious money promise?
episode.description: A caller claims to be from Kash’s bank and asks for her one-time password. Coin teaches one simple safety rule: never share an OTP or PIN, even with someone claiming to represent your bank. General money education only.
